description: Compact and efficient. Living bright bedrooms dim. Deep — views through multiple spaces. Short connecting link between entry and living area. Kitchen: single-wall, no island or peninsula — counter set back from windows, moderate natural light. Cook faces the wall — back to the living and dining area. One active cook at a time. Fully open plan — no wall separates kitchen from dining and living. Living arrangement: split seating-kitchen-dining, kitchen on end wall. Seating: An L-shaped sofa in the lower-left corner faces inward toward the room; a smaller sofa or chair sits along the lower wall facing up toward the TV. Dining table (6 seats). TV on wall same wall as entry. Cook cannot see TV from cooking position. Diners do not face the TV. Entry: direct into kitchen, first thing visible on arrival is kitchen. Entry area has space for coat and shoe storage. No door between entry and living — relevant where local regulations require separation. Double bedroom — accessed via own door off corridor, no walk-in wardrobe. Double bedroom closest to entry — lighter acoustic separation from the arrival zone. Secondary bedroom 1 — accessed via own door off corridor. The single bedroom can function as a dedicated home office, hobby room, guest room, or children's bedroom. 0 of 1 have a desk visible in plan. Single bedroom use options: children's bedroom / dedicated home office / hobby or creative studio / guest room. Storage: one wardrobe. Sanitary rooms: bathroom (shower and toilet); separate WC. One bathroom plus separate WC — one person can shower while another uses the toilet. Simultaneous showering not possible. Suits: couples needing a dedicated home office or hobby room; small families with one child. Not suitable for: large families needing more than two bedrooms; households requiring a home office with a dedicated desk; people who want a bathtub for bathing; those needing generous storage or a walk-in wardrobe.
